title: Books and their authors
statementMd:
List each book title with its author's name.

Expected columns: `title`, `author`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.title, a.name AS author FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id;
```
